population_scope: game pages visible in one independent public-feed tracking system, not paid publisher or game sales census
mechanical_caveats: A game update may cause a second new-feed appearance; first sightings do not automatically equal commercial launch dates.
The source estimates all visible games across mixed price and genre categories, including free titles.
Featured inclusion is curated and may disproportionately select established publishers.
An un-rated listing may have paid buyers, downloads, browser plays or none; zero ratings cannot proxy zero revenue.
112 days featured includes deep curated catalog placements that may not be visible on the first homepage viewport.
Sampling covers this public feed system only, not a validated 2026 all-itch complete release census.
No exact paid-only new game release rate, unique paying buyers, orders or developer profits were obtained.
